sourceRefs.locator: Image description, attribution and CC0 licensing; source digitisation Uppsala University Library, Alvin record 60279.
John 12:38, fol. 78r (facsimile 99). The tokens hauseinai and unsarai give the second possessive example in its inflected form.
Object description following the interview with Lars Munkhammar, particularly the four arches, one for each evangelist, and their use as Gospel cross-references.

alt.de: Johannes 12,37–43 auf Blatt 78r. Unter den verblassten silbernen und goldenen Schriftzeilen auf purpurfarbenem Grund stehen vier kleine Säulenbögen mit Verweisen.
alt.en: John 12.37–43 on folio 78r. Four small arches with Gospel references sit beneath faded silver and gold lettering on purple parchment.
